name: stm32f303
description: ST STM32F303xE (Cortex-M4F 72 MHz, 512 KB flash, 64 KB SRAM + 16 KB CCM, USB FS device, bxCAN, 5 U(S)ARTs, 4 SPI, 3 I2C, ADC1, DAC, TIM1/2/3/4/6/7/8/15/16/17): GNU Arm toolchain with the STM32CubeF3 HAL/LL, Renode stm32f303 platform

toolchain.notes: Link with a STM32F303RETx_FLASH.ld and startup_stm32f303xe.s from a Cube example (Projects/STM32F303RE-Nucleo/Templates). Whole Cube examples build with tools/stm32cube/build_example.py in the Renode tree; CubeIDE board projects build with `embeddyn mechatronics import`.

image.notes: load the ELF; the vector table is at 0x08000000

renode.notes: Boards: platforms/boards/st/nucleo_f303re.repl (LD2 PA5 = led2, B1 PC13 = sysbus.gpioPortC.userButton, active low, VCP usart2). The RCC clock tree (HSI/HSE, PREDIV, PLL, HPRE, PPRE1/PPRE2) drives SysTick and the timers; bit-band aliases at 0x22000000/0x42000000. DMA1 (7) and DMA2 (5) channels take their fixed requests. EXTI lines take the port SYSCFG_EXTICR selects. ADC1: 'adc1 SetVoltage microvolts channel'. DAC: 'dac OutputVoltage 0'. USB FS device with the packet memory view at 0x40006000. Pins: add 'pins: Miscellaneous.PinRecorder @ gpioPortA 0' and connections such as 'gpioPortA:' / '    5 -> led2@0 | pins@5' (a .repl file), then 'sysbus.gpioPortA.pins Edges 5'. Docs: tools/stm32cube/README.md.

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with the STM32CubeF3 examples (tools/stm32cube/run_examples.py with examples_f303.txt in the Renode tree)
